name: Banh quy hat bang
summary: Biscuits made with hạt bàng, in chocolate or traditional fillings. They began as the welcome biscuit at hotel reception desks and now come from a workshop on Nguyễn Duy Trinh.
culture: The biscuits are an OCOP three-star product, and the same workshop makes candied kernels.
howToEat: Buy a pack to take home, or take the biscuit a hotel desk sets out.
where: Nguyễn Duy Trinh, khu 5, where the workshop is.
seoTitle: Banh quy hat bang — hat bang biscuits in Con Dao
seoDescription: Bánh quy hạt bàng are OCOP three-star biscuits made with bàng kernels on Nguyễn Duy Trinh, in chocolate and traditional fillings.
